articles.title: Golden Boot on the Line: England-France Third-Place Clash Carries High Stakes
articles.summary: England's semi-final heartbreak isn't the end: Saturday's third-place match against France could crown the Golden Boot winner. Kylian Mbappe and Lionel Messi are deadlocked at 8 goals, with Mbappe needing just one more to seize the lead.

articles.title: Trump's Primetime Address on 2020 Election Integrity: Separating Influence from Interference
articles.summary: President Trump's July 16 speech will spotlight 2020 election security, citing newly declassified intelligence. But experts maintain the election was secure, distinguishing between foreign influence campaigns and actual vote tampering.

articles.title: Falklands Banner at World Cup Semi-Final Ignites UK-Argentina Sovereignty Row
articles.summary: Argentina players' 'Las Malvinas son Argentinas' banner after their 2-1 win over England drew swift UK condemnation. Downing Street retorted that the Falklands 'definitely are' British, citing the islanders' 2013 vote.
